purpose: Read recurrence-generated, unskipped and currently unscheduled self-owned Occurrences whose typed expectation coordinate intersects one bounded Timeline window.

routine.return_type: TABLE(occurrence_ref uuid, source_native_ref uuid, governing_recurrence_state_ref uuid, origin_code text, family_code text, generated_date date, generated_wall_time time without time zone, clock_basis_code text, zone_id text, resolved_at timestamp with time zone, expected_at timestamp with time zone, period_start_date date, period_end_date_exclusive date, frame_code text, quota_zone_id text, position_index integer, skipped boolean, skip_reason text, skipped_at timestamp with time zone)

state_history.current_binding: Reads immutable Occurrence provenance and current Schedule binding without rewriting either.
state_history.chronology: Window membership is derived from the stored typed Occurrence coordinate in the authenticated effective timezone; a current Schedule removes the Occurrence from the expected-unscheduled projection.
state_history.immutability_policy: Read-only bounded self-scoped capability; runtime retains no direct table privileges on B06-C provenance tables.

lifecycle.retention: Exists while B06-D Timeline Occurrence integration is materialized.
